name: Polymaker
summary: R&D-led filament manufacturer headquartered in Changshu, China, with offices in Shanghai, Utrecht and Houston. Its catalog spans budget aesthetic PLA (PolyTerra/Panchroma) through engineering composites (Fiberon, PolyMax), and it is one of very few Chinese-origin brands with confirmed US manufacturing capacity.

product_lines.name: PolyLite™ PLA Pro / Polymaker™ PLA Pro
PolyMax™ PLA
product_lines.notes: Nano-reinforced impact-toughened PLA: tensile 41.3 MPa XY / 32.4 MPa Z, elongation 5.7%/4.7%, Charpy 38.9 kJ/m2, Tg 61 C, HDT 52.3 C @1.8MPa.

product_lines.name: PolySonic™ PLA / PLA Pro
product_lines.notes: High-flow PLA for high-speed printers; "PolySonic PLA" is a pla-hf alias.

product_lines.name: Draft PLA
product_lines.notes: Fast, low-precision draft PLA; base chemistry unchanged.

product_lines.name: HT-PLA
product_lines.notes: Heat-resistant crystallizable/annealable PLA — an annealed-crystallinity grade with no catalog id.

product_lines.name: HT-PLA-GF
product_lines.notes: Glass-fiber heat-resistant PLA; maps on the GF-PLA chemistry, pla-gf id is provisional. The HT (annealable) aspect is not captured by any id.

product_lines.name: Panchroma™ PLA (standard, translucent, neon, UV-shift, marble, galaxy, starlight, celestial, metallic)
product_lines.notes: Cosmetic-additive variants on a base PLA; no chemistry change.

product_lines.name: Panchroma™ PLA Dual-Tone
product_lines.notes: Two-tone coextruded PLA; colour-transition SKU rather than an along-strand dye gradient.

product_lines.name: Panchroma™ CoPE
product_lines.notes: High-speed copolyester; "Panchroma CoPE" is a cope alias.

product_lines.name: PolyTerra™ PLA
product_lines.notes: Eco/matte PLA line, since largely folded into Panchroma.

product_lines.name: PolyMax™ PETG
product_lines.notes: Impact-toughened PETG; no toughened-PETG id in catalog.

product_lines.name: PolyLite™ ABS / Polymaker™ ABS Pro / ABS Max
PolyLite™ PC / PolyMax™ PC
product_lines.notes: Standard and toughened polycarbonate; a flame-retardant PC-FR variant also exists. (A PC-PBT alloy was cited in an earlier pass but was not found in this catalog review.)

product_lines.name: PolyFlex™ TPU95 / TPU95-HF
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A flexible TPU; "PolyFlex TPU95" is a tpu-95a alias. HF is a high-flow reformulation, same hardness.

product_lines.name: PolyMide™ CoPA
product_lines.notes: Co-polyamide nylon blend, not a straight PA6/PA66/PA12 grade; "CoPA" is a pa alias.

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PA6-GF25
product_lines.notes: PA6 + 25% glass fiber; pa6-gf id is provisional.

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PA612-CF15
product_lines.notes: PA612 + 15% carbon fiber; the catalog has pa6-cf/pa12-cf but no PA612 grade. Lower moisture uptake than PA6-CF.

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PET-GF15
product_lines.notes: PET + 15% glass fiber; no glass-fiber PET id exists (pet-cf only).

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PETG-rCF08
product_lines.notes: PETG + 8% recycled carbon fiber; recycled feedstock is the only delta vs petg-cf.

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PA612-ESD
product_lines.notes: Static-dissipative PA612 composite; no PA612 and no nylon-ESD id in catalog.

product_lines.name: Fiberon™ PPS-GF20
product_lines.notes: PPS + 20% glass fiber; catalog has pps and pps-cf but no glass-filled PPS id.

product_lines.name: PolyCast™
product_lines.notes: Same PVB chemistry as PolySmooth, tuned for lost-wax burnout casting.

product_lines.name: PolySupport™
product_lines.notes: Breakaway (peel-away) support material for PLA/PA12; no breakaway-support id in catalog (only soluble pva/bvoh and hips).

additional_notes: Primary manufacturing in Changshu, China, with expanded production in Houston, Texas from 2024. Sells the PolyDryer drying/storage hardware; no build plates or print surfaces found, so makes_plates is left unset. Standard and Pro PLA lines run roughly $25-30/kg with engineering composites higher. Won 'Material Company of the Year' at the 3D Printing Industry Awards twice within five years, most recently January 2023. Additional Instagram accounts exist for polymaker_figurines and polymaker_education.

provenance.conflicts: Legal entity name unconfirmed — 'Polymaker LLC' appears on ZoomInfo and a Shanghai/Changshu Chinese entity is implied, but neither was verified from official filings. The owner-verified Overture relationship is not acknowledged in any Polymaker-published source; recorded as authoritative but externally uncorroborated. Bambu Lab line-level attribution remains open.
